anomalies.description: A black SUV is seen swerving sharply to the right and colliding with a dark hatchback parked or stopped on the shoulder, causing visible damage and displacement of the hatchback. The impact occurs between frames f0 and f2, with aftermath visible through f3.

Vehicle veers sharply right off the paved road onto a dirt shoulder, kicking up a large cloud of dust that completely obscures the view by 19.0s, indicating a loss of control and likely collision with terrain or object.
Vehicle veers off paved road onto dirt shoulder, kicks up massive dust cloud that completely obscures view; consistent with loss of control and collision with roadside terrain or object.

The instantaneous generation of an extremely dense, opaque cloud filling the windshield within ~1.5 seconds suggests a blast event (e.g., vehicle fire/explosion or roadside detonation), rather than a gradual dust-up from a simple crash. The cloud expands outward rapidly from a central point near the road ahead.
